{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|reactor}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Reactors1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Hypermatter reactors on [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].]]
{{Quote|Once the shield is down, our cruisers will create a perimeter, while the fighters fly into the superstructure and attempt to knock out the main reactor.|Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] details the Rebel Alliance's [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack plan]] against the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''reactor''', also called a '''main reactor''' or '''reactor core''', was a central power generating facility found in [[Starship/Legends|starships]], [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and planet-bound power plants of virtually any size.

==History==
[[File:DeathStar2Core.png|thumb|left|200px|The Second Death Star's reactor, moments before its destruction.]]
During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] accidentally destroyed the starboard reactor of the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']], and started a chain reaction. The destruction also disabled the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] army.

Reactors could function on vastly different principles, ranging from chemical reactions to [[nuclear fission]] and [[Nuclear fusion|fusion]] to [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter annihilation]].

The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]], [[Death Star II/Legends|second]], and [[Death Star III|third]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] utilized [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] reactor cores, which in both cases were exploited by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to destroy the gargantuan battlestations. The main reactor was not a weak point in the Death Star I. It was only a section that was not well protected by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] because they assumed no threat could come close to doing damage. The weakness on the Death Star(s) were that small craft were able to avoid the heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. Thus, they could fly down the polar trench and destroy the huge battle station.
